title: Emile's habit of practicing early each morning
summary: Russell asks Mrs. Barnes to repeat how Emile practiced first thing every morning; the interviewer notes it gets the music in his head.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: You know, we were just talking about Mrs. Barnes about how Miele used to practice. Yeah. You mind telling that again? Used to practice early in the morning, you say?
Yeah. Used to practice early in the morning. That was his beginning. You see, before he'd done anything in the morning, when he'd first get up, that's what he'd done.
